nodes.description: Owned.owner: address of the current contract owner, initialised from msg.sender in the Owned constructor.
Owned.newOwner: pending owner address used by the two-step ownership transfer.
AlicToken.symbol public string, set to "ALIC" in the constructor.
AlicToken.name public string, set to "Alicoin" in the constructor.
AlicToken.decimals public uint8, set to 18 in the constructor.
AlicToken._totalSupply: total token supply minted to the deployer in the constructor.
mapping(address => uint) balances: token balance ledger of AlicToken.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) allowed: ERC20 allowance ledger of AlicToken.
SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b) pure returns (uint c): adds and requires c >= a.
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b) pure returns (uint c): requires b <= a then subtracts.
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b) pure returns (uint c): multiplies and requires a == 0 || c / a == b.
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b) pure returns (uint c): requires b > 0 then divides.
Owned() constructor: sets owner = msg.sender.
Owned.transferOwnership(address _newOwner) public onlyOwner: stages the new owner.
Owned.acceptOwnership() public: only newOwner may finalise and become owner.
AlicToken() constructor: sets symbol, name, decimals, _totalSupply and seeds the deployer balance.
AlicToken.totalSupply() constant returns (uint): _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] using raw subtraction.
AlicToken.balanceOf(address tokenOwner) constant returns (uint balance): reads balances.
AlicToken.transfer(address to, uint tokens): debits msg.sender and credits to using safeSub/safeAdd.
AlicToken.approve(address spender, uint tokens): writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
AlicToken.transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens): moves balances and reduces allowance.
AlicToken.allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender) constant returns (uint remaining).
AlicToken.approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data): writes allowance then calls the spender contract.
AlicToken fallback function () public payable: always reverts, refuses ETH.
AlicToken.transferAnyERC20Token(address tokenAddress, uint tokens) public onlyOwner: forwards an arbitrary external call.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used as owner, balance key and allowance key.
Arithmetic: c = a + b inside safeAdd, guarded by require(c >= a).
Arithmetic: c = a - b inside safeSub, guarded by require(b <= a).
Arithmetic: c = a * b inside safeMul, guarded by require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
Arithmetic: c = a / b inside safeDiv, guarded by require(b > 0).
State write: balances[msg.sender] and balances[to] mutated in transfer via safeSub/safeAdd.
State write: balances[from], allowed[from][msg.sender] and balances[to] mutated in transferFrom.
External call: ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) executed after the allowance write.
External call: ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) on an owner-supplied contract address.
Arithmetic: unchecked raw subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] in totalSupply.

Parameter a is an operand of the subtraction c = a - b performed in safeSub.
Parameter b is an operand of the subtraction c = a - b performed in safeSub.
safeSub executes the uint subtraction c = a - b guarded by require(b <= a).

Parameter b is an operand of the multiplication c = a * b performed in safeMul.
safeMul executes the uint multiplication c = a * b, overflow-guarded by c / a == b.
Parameter a is the dividend of the division c = a / b in safeDiv.
Parameter b is the divisor of c = a / b in safeDiv, guarded by require(b > 0).
safeDiv executes the uint division c = a / b.
